verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a key-gated REST API for creating and managing cloud resources, including programmatic instance launch with cloud-init launch-time configuration, and a runtime probe confirms the API is live. That makes headless, scripted provisioning possible. However, there is no first-party CLI and no documented CI integration; the only CLI is an unofficial community project, which earns no credit, and documented rate limits (1 req/s, launches throttled per 12s) constrain automation. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/pipeline integration guides or examples, and independent corroboration of first-party headless automation workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can also launch instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
If you're launching your instance with the Lambda Cloud API, you can add launch-time configuration instructions using cloud-init.
